scientific_question: Why does the frozen P_T global branch form an expected-rank-like coherent potential yet express excessive nonlearned symbolic-distance dependence?
current_theory: Differential evidence admission into P_T and L_T is the working local/global learning mechanism. The remaining excessive symbolic-distance slope is a separate global-policy problem dominated by nonlearned queries.
diagnostic_hypothesis: The pure L-off global margin can be localized into additive-potential geometry, potential amplitude, Hodge residual, and the fixed sigmoid choice link without changing or fitting the model.
claim_boundary: This is a two-frozen-backbone, within-network, read-only source localization. It can distinguish registered policy-chain contributions and constrain the next intervention family. It cannot prove a unique cause from an unresolved contrast, establish network-population prevalence, fit a temperature, change v2.4, or evaluate a new model.
registration_timing: Frozen after fresh-backbone v2.4 confirmation and before writing or executing this diagnostic.

network_contract.checkpoint_selection: Use exactly the jointly hash-locked final checkpoints from the fresh v2.4 confirmation.
network_contract.primary_condition: Pure L-off v1/global branch with intact P_T and frozen W_out; no local trace is constructed or read.
network_contract.within_network_inference: Bootstrap participants separately within each network. Never pool participant rows across networks.

runtime_contract.all_seed_execution: Both mandatory networks must be analyzed in one command before the result is written.

field_contract.edge_order: All 28 unordered item pairs in lexicographic integer order.
field_contract.sign: Every margin is orientation-antisymmetrized so positive means the first item is preferred as higher.
field_contract.global_margin: m_ij=0.5[logit(i,j)-logit(j,i)] from the intact frozen P_T branch with L off.
field_contract.hodge_decomposition: m=g+c with s=pinv(B)m, g=Bs, and c=m-g on the complete graph.
field_contract.potential_scale_shape: Center s, define a=||s||_2 and hat_s=s/a, so g=a B hat_s and beta_g=a beta_hat_s exactly.
field_contract.correctness: Multiply pair fields by y_ij in {+1,-1} from the source-correct true ranking.
field_contract.primary_pair_subset: The 20 nonlearned pairs only; learned support pairs are excluded before every slope.
field_contract.subject_slope: OLS slope cov(value,d)/var(d) over the fixed 20 nonlearned pairs, computed separately for every participant.
field_contract.posterior_geometry: Use the terminal exact-posterior pair field from the same realized support evidence and posterior temperature 0.05; its normalized Hodge potential is algebraically the normalized expected-rank potential.
field_contract.choice_link: p_ij=sigmoid(y_ij m_ij/T) at the frozen T=0.25; there is no temperature search or refit.

exact_decompositions.choice_link: Within subject fit p=intercept+kappa*q+e over nonlearned pairs, where q=y m. Then beta_p=kappa beta_m+beta_e exactly.
exact_decompositions.choice_sensitivity: Report mean p(1-p)/T as a descriptive local derivative, not a fitted parameter.

registered_diagnoses.global_potential_dominance: Within each network, beta_m lower bound >0 and (beta_g-0.9 beta_m) lower bound >0.
registered_diagnoses.normalized_geometry_excess: Within each network, lower bound of beta_hat_s-beta_hat_s_posterior >0.
registered_diagnoses.positive_residual_contribution: Within each network, beta_c lower bound >0.
registered_diagnoses.neural_probability_slope_excess: Within each network, lower bound of beta_p-beta_p_posterior >0.
registered_diagnoses.choice_link_amplification: Within each network, beta_e lower bound >0.
registered_diagnoses.choice_link_compression: Within each network, beta_e upper bound <0.
registered_diagnoses.unresolved_rule: An interval containing zero is unresolved, never equivalence or evidence of absence.
registered_diagnoses.replication_rule: A diagnosis is replicated only when its stated rule passes separately in both mandatory networks.

outcome_contingent_interpretation.potential_geometry: If potential dominance and normalized geometry excess replicate, localize the discrepancy to P_T-to-potential assembly geometry before policy scaling.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.potential_scale: If probability-slope excess and potential dominance replicate, normalized geometry excess does not replicate, and the choice link is compressive rather than amplifying, treat over-sharp potential scaling as the leading next hypothesis but do not claim normalized geometry equivalence.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.hodge_residual: If a positive residual contribution replicates and potential dominance fails, localize material distance structure outside the additive potential.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.choice_link: If choice-link amplification replicates, treat the fixed nonlinear policy link as an independent contributor; if compression replicates, it attenuates rather than creates the upstream slope.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.mixed_or_unresolved: Preserve every supported component and freeze a later discriminating intervention; do not fit a temperature or edit v2.4 inside this diagnostic.

secondary_preservation_check.source: Use only the already frozen v2.4 confirmation result; do not rerun or mix L_T into the primary decomposition.
secondary_preservation_check.question: Do the dual-intact exact slope and dominant nonlearned contribution retain the same qualitative fingerprint in both networks?

integrity_gates.all_artifact_hashes: must match the joint v2.4 confirmation artifact lock

reporting.next_action: No intervention is authorized by this contract. Use the replicated localization pattern to preregister a separate next candidate.
